# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Setup ------------------------------------------------------------
src <- if (file.exists("Analysis.R")) "Analysis.R" else "../analysis/Analysis.R"
source(src)
library(purrr)
# DGP2, p = 50, s = 4, c = 1, n ∈ {500..10k}, 1000 reps.
# Four cv.balnet tuning rules + balnet0; seed-shared, misspec − correct matched.
res <- if (dir.exists("results2")) "results2/" else "../results2/"
df_cvt <- bind_rows(
  load_sim(paste0(res, "cvtunecorrect.csv.gz")),
  load_sim(paste0(res, "cvtunemisspec.csv.gz")),
  .id = "spec"
) |> mutate(misspec = spec == "2")
summ_cvt <- summarise_sim(df_cvt)
est_cvt <- c("bal_refit", "imb_refit", "bal_sub", "imb_sub", "balnet0")
# screen: full reps, no NAs, no errors
stopifnot(all(summ_cvt$m == 1000), sum(summ_cvt$n_na) == 0,
          all(df_cvt$err == ""))

lab_est <- c(lab_est,
             bal_refit = "CV balance loss (refit)",
             imb_refit = "CV imbalance (refit)",
             bal_sub   = "CV balance loss (subsampled)",
             imb_sub   = "CV imbalance (subsampled)")
pal_est <- c(pal_est,
             bal_refit = "#0072B2", imb_refit = "#CC79A7",
             bal_sub   = "#D55E00", imb_sub   = "#56B4E9")
```

note# fix cv.loss overflow in run script.

# Correct vs Misspeccified

```{r}
# RMSE | |Bias| vs n, correct vs misspecified, per outcome
walk(names(oc_labs)[1:2], \(oc) print(
  panel(summ_cvt, oc, ests = est_cvt,
        extra = list(scale_x_n, facet_wrap(~misspec, labeller = label_both)))))
perf_table(summ_cvt, ests = est_cvt, cols = c("misspec", "n"),
           group = "outcome",
           span_lab = \(s) ifelse(s, "Misspecified", "Correct"),
           span_desc = FALSE,
           title = "CV tuning rules vs balnet0 (DGP2, c = 1)")
# RMSE DECOMP
walk(c(FALSE, TRUE), \(ms)
     print(decomp_plot(filter(summ_cvt, misspec == .env$ms), ests = est_cvt,
                       title = paste0("MSE decomposition (%) \u2014 ",
                                      ifelse(ms, "misspecified", "correct")))))


```

CV balance loss subsampled best performer, identical to Balnet

```{r}
# ── E3-CV: four CV tuning rules, degrading overlap (DGP2, correct spec) ──

cv_raw <- fread("../results2/cvtuneoverlap.csv.gz")

# data-quality screen first
cv_raw[, .(reps = .N, nas = sum(is.na(est)), errs = sum(!is.na(err))),
       by = .(n, overlap, outcome, estimator)][reps != 1000 | nas > 0 | errs > 0]

cvov <- <summariser used for summ_ov>(cv_raw) |> mutate(cf = as_c(overlap))

est_cv4_show <- c("bal_refit", "imb_refit", "bal_sub", "imb_sub", "balnet0")
ov_facets    <- list(scale_x_n, facet_wrap(~cf, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y"))

# plots > RMSE decomp
for (oc in names(oc_labs)) {
  print(panel(cvov, oc, ests = est_cv4_show, extra = ov_facets))
  print(decomp_plot(filter(cvov, outcome == oc), ests = est_cv4_show, cols = cf,
                    title = paste("RMSE Decomposition (%),", oc_labs[oc])))
}

# table
perf_table(cvov, cols = c("overlap", "n"), group = "outcome",
           title = "CV tuning rules under degrading overlap (DGP2)")
extreme_heat(cvov)
```
